title: Lace Ruffle Crop Cami & High Waist Flared Midi Skirt 2-Piece Set
body_html:
Product Details

Top Details

  • Neckline: Sweetheart square cami neck with delicate lace trim along the bust edge
  • Straps: Thin spaghetti straps decorated with asymmetric flutter ruffle cap sleeves
  • Front Design: Double layered cascading ruffle hem, vertical single-breasted decorative buttons at center front
  • Silhouette: Ultra cropped short length to expose waist, slim fit bust silhouette
  • Fabric: Sheer floral lace overlay with solid inner lining to avoid transparency

Skirt Details

  • Waist: High-rise fitted waistband with curved scalloped decorative stitching on front waist
  • Silhouette: A-line flared midi length, vertical panel stitching to create soft flowing drape
  • Fabric: All-over subtle floral jacquard sheer fabric, full lightweight lining, ruffled wavy bottom hem Style Positioning Mediterranean vacation / Cottagecore romantic / Sweet boho casual / Seaside travel matching set

Fabric & Thickness

Lightweight breathable jacquard lace blend, cool and airy for hot summer weather.

Applicable Scenarios

Coastal town sightseeing, café dates, beach strolls, travel portrait shooting, weekend picnic outings.

Fit Feature

Cropped ruffle cami balances the high-waisted flared midi skirt, optimizes body proportion and lengthens legs; soft flowy fabric creates gentle movement when walking.

Size Chart

Note

  1. Slight stretch fabric on waistband; 2~3cm manual measuring deviation is normal.
  2. All-white lace jacquard + multi-layer ruffle design is the core romantic highlight, full of vacation gentle atmosphere.
  3. Matching reference as pictured: black thin strap platform flip flops, chunky gold bangle bracelets, dainty gold drop earrings, mini woven straw crossbody bag.
  4. Separable wearing design: crop cami can match denim shorts; midi skirt can pair with plain linen tees for separate daily collocation.
